body: This 'Enter not working' affects a number of modals, including the "create tag" from commits page "Operations" button, e.g. we need a general solution.

Maybe we should ditch our custom solution and should use the [new dialog HTML Element](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/dialog). According to [Can I Use](https://caniuse.com/mdn-html_elements_dialog), it is already supported by 92.86% of the Web Users.
Yes, that would be preferred as we can then get rid of the fomantic modal module.

It's caused by abuse of Fomantic Modal in old code.

I think the new "form-fetch-action" could help and could be a clear solution.
